title: TUI: Questions tab across projects
lead: Decided #99 ui.answer-ui: besides the row pane, a Questions tab lists every open question (engine stops and open adj questions) across projects. Depends on the pane slice.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Decided #99 ui.answer-ui: besides the row pane, a Questions tab lists every open question (engine stops and open adj questions) across projects. Depends on the pane slice.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The tab lists open questions from all projects, each naming its project.
- Enter opens the same answer pane.
- No questions shows an empty-state line.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.
